metadata.description: Vitalii's personal collection of reusable Claude Code plugins — rules, skills, commands, agents, hooks, and scripts battle-tested at work and reused across projects.

plugins.name: rules
plugins.description: Reusable, language-neutral convention rules (Makefile, .env, comments) plus a /rules:install command to drop them into any project's .claude/rules/.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Reusable, language- and project-neutral skills. Currently: writing-knowledge-docs — durable, code-grounded explanations of how a subsystem works.
